sources.observed: North-up aerial inspected with georegistered OSM overlay. External Chapel retail walls, station rooftop parking and entrance recess, rear roof ranges and Corporation/Cambridge passages. Imagery capture date not established.
Chapel bend, Tulketh mouth, Eastbank threshold, shopping block roof and courtyard divisions. External outlines agree at block-plan precision; fine eaves offsets are not surveyed.

Pedestrian Chapel entrance: dark central slab route, lighter margins, large planters, stainless entrance bollards, paired curved lamps, three-storey terrace and taller Costa/Primark wall. Eastbank paving recently renewed.
Station Approach opening, broad grey slab pedestrian corridor, dark furniture strips, long slatted benches and curved lamps. Exact present furniture positions not established.
Open pedestrian entrance into Chapel Street; two-storey station retail corner, three-storey Waterstones range. This is not an asphalt side road.
Covered Station Approach refurbishment, with public access retained. Does not establish a complete repaving of Chapel Street; temporary compound omitted.
OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0. Ways 371203985, 371199519, 30141945, 371730196 used as aerial-checked external outline controls. Not accepted as separate buildings or reliable height records.

private_captures: ../references/station-quarter/; references are not distributed or used as published texture pixels.
limitations: Google 3D Earth was attempted in headed GPU sessions but unavailable; NVIDIA driver did not respond and Maps reported 3D Earth unavailable. No 3D roof orbit achieved for this pass.
Height bounds are storey-based estimates with roughly 2–4 m uncertainty. Flat tops are placeholder bounds, not reconstructed roofs.
Aerial plan registration has approximately 1–2 m uncertainty, particularly roof-to-wall offsets. Not cadastral or engineering survey.
Ground datum is inherited from London Street; longitudinal levels are not surveyed.
Furniture family is observed; exact counts and placements are provisional, based on the dated views and aerial tree/furniture strips.
Station platforms, full Eastbank highway works and fine facade details are outside this bounded pass.
